🎙️ Voice Settings

Configure the Bodhan AI speech-to-text service that powers voice dictation (the 🎤 buttons) across the platform. Transcription only. Your API key is stored securely server-side and is never displayed back — leave the key field blank to keep the existing one.

…
The full Bodhan speech-to-text endpoint (HTTPS).
Write-only — sent to the server and never shown again.
Advanced — request shape (only if Bodhan's API differs from the defaults)
Response text path is dotted, e.g. result.text.
Once saved, voice works immediately (no restart). Test it in Court Console → Disposal → Dispose → 🎤 Dictate, or any 🎤 button. Only admins/stewards can change this. The key lives server-side on the durable volume; if this deployment later gains Vault access it can be moved there.
